name: kalshi-history-candles
notes: Structural gates over one `candles` pull of a source kalshi-history-candles-hourly-* (event-level 1-minute candles of the hourly ladders). The row is the kalshi pack's candle, so these restate suite-kalshi-crypto-candles.json's rules and extend them to the fields that suite leaves unchecked (mean, yes_bid_close, yes_ask_close, open_interest), which are the quote columns the hourly document reads. Prices are dollars in [0, 1]. A minute with no trade has null prices, which in_range skips by design. Run: python -m dskit.onboarding validate --suite configs/suite-kalshi-history-candles.json --snapshot <snapshot-vid> --root <store root>.

rules.notes: An empty pull means no market in range or a wrong series list.
Every candle belongs to a market; the reader keys on (ticker, ts).
The candle's END instant in epoch seconds.
Epoch SECONDS between 2023-11 and 2100: a millisecond value (about 1.7e12) fails, which is the unit slip the reader also refuses.
A contract pays 1 dollar; a price outside [0, 1] is a unit slip upstream.
The volume-weighted mean price of the minute, in dollars.
The best YES bid at the minute's end, in dollars: what the hourly document's quote reads.
The best YES ask at the minute's end, in dollars: what the hourly document's quote reads.
The pack drops candles still forming at the capture instant; one dated after acquisition is a defect.
